title: Abba bar Abbahu

paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud, Bava Kamma, chapter 1, halakhah 1; Hyman identifies him as Rabbah bar Avuha.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The identification as Rabbah bar Avuha is Hyman’s statement. The Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 1:1 asks who Abba is and gives רבי או אבא בר אבוה; that witness does not by itself establish Hyman’s identification.

The saved Guggenheimer Bava Kamma1:1 scalar asks who Abba is and offers Rabbi or Abba bar Avuha. It supports the mention, not Hyman’s separate identification as Rabbah bar Avuha. Heading אבהו and body/witness אבוה remain distinct; the older trivial-variant/no-reader-note decision is qualified rather than silently harmonized.
